title.zh: 对未来的一个赌注，怎么可能有“公道价”？
title.en: How can anyone put a fair price on a bet about the future?

name.en: Forward contracts and cost of carry

summary.zh: 由无风险借贷与现货分红唯一钉死的无套利远期定价，与对未来涨跌的主观猜测无关。
summary.en: No-arbitrage forward pricing pinned by risk-free financing and dividend yield rather than directional forecasts.

name.zh: 期权收益折线与看涨-看跌平价
name.en: Option payoff kinks and put-call parity

summary.zh: 同一执行价和到期日的欧式看涨、看跌期权与现值现金、现货之间的刚性等式。
summary.en: Rigid replication identity linking European calls, puts, discounted strike cash, and spot shares.

name.zh: 二叉树复制与风险中性定价

summary.zh: 用股票与借贷复制期权两态收益，使无套利价格独立于个人对上涨概率的主观判断。
summary.en: Replicating two-state option payoffs with stock and borrowing, making the no-arbitrage price independent of subjective probabilities.

name.zh: 多步二叉树与美式提前行权
name.en: Multi-step CRR tree and American early exercise

summary.zh: N 步树向连续极限的收敛过程，以及倒推比较立即行权与继续持有的美式期权边界。
summary.en: Convergence of N-step Cox-Ross-Rubinstein trees to continuous prices and backward induction for early exercise boundaries.

name.zh: 几何布朗运动与波动率拖累
name.en: Geometric Brownian motion and volatility drag

summary.zh: 连续复利随机游走中对数正态分布的均值与中位数劈叉及 −½σ² 拖累效应。
summary.en: Lognormal paths separating arithmetic mean from typical median growth via the −½σ² Ito drift correction.

name.zh: 布莱克-斯科尔斯偏微分方程

summary.zh: 连续对冲消去漂移项 μ 后得到的无套利扩散偏微分方程及其有限差分数值解。
summary.en: Drift-free diffusion PDE obtained by continuous hedging, mirrored by Crank-Nicolson finite differences.

name.zh: 希腊字母与离散 Delta 对冲误差
name.en: Option Greeks and discrete delta-hedging error

summary.zh: Delta/Gamma/Vega/Theta 的敏感度含义，以及离散调仓方差、实现波动率与交易成本对损益的决定作用。
summary.en: Greeks sensitivities and Monte Carlo hedging showing variance scaling, realized-vs-implied vol spread, and transaction costs.

name.zh: 隐含波动率微笑、肥尾与聚类
name.en: Implied volatility smile, fat tails, and clustering

summary.zh: SPX 真实期权链左侧陡峭偏斜、标普十年肥尾日收益与波动率聚类对常数正态模型的证伪。
summary.en: Empirical SPX skew, fat-tailed daily equity returns, and volatility clustering breaking constant-volatility assumptions.

name.zh: 随机波动率模型与不完备市场

summary.zh: 把波动率本身设为负相关均值回复随机过程如何生成微笑与偏斜，以及无法单靠现货对冲的本质限制。
summary.en: Generating smiles and equity skew with correlated variance diffusion while highlighting incomplete-market hedging limits.

name.zh: 实体风险转移与散户期权摩擦损耗
name.en: Corporate risk transfer vs. retail option friction

summary.zh: 企业对冲如何压缩经营利润波动、BIS 名义本金与净信用敞口层级，以及短线散户买卖点差与期望负收益实证。
summary.en: Contrast between commercial hedging, BIS notional-to-net exposure netting, and empirical retail option losses from spreads and IV crush.

name.zh: 0DTE 末日 Gamma、CCP 与永续资金费
name.en: 0DTE gamma spikes, central clearing, and perpetual funding

summary.zh: 从 LIBOR 过渡至 SOFR、中央对手方清算制度，到当代 0DTE 末日期权与永续合约资金费率演化。
summary.en: Post-crisis CCP clearing and SOFR transition alongside modern SPX 0DTE gamma concentration and perpetual funding convergence.
